paite: Levi tapa Kohath, huai tapa Izhar, huai tapa Korah pen Eliab tapate, Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On leh Reuben tapate'n mite api ua;
heading: Korah, Dathan Leh Abiram Helna
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

paite: Israel suante, mi tallang deuhdeuh mipi omkhawmte lak a heutu vaihawmmi dia telte lak a mi zanih-le-sawmnga toh Mosi ma ah ava kisa uhi.
english: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm ua, akiang uah, "Na uang lua uh, na uang lua uh, omkhawm mipite lah asiangthou chiat ngal ua, TOUPA alak uah a-om chih mu zenpi a, bangziak a TOUPA mipi omkhawmte tung a kikoih na hi ua?" achi uh.
english: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them: why then lift yourselves up above the assembly of Yahweh?”

paite: Mosi in huai azak in amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face:

paite: Korah leh apawlte tengteng kiang ah, "Zingchiang in TOUPA'N amah ate kuate ahi ua, kuate ahia siangthou, chih ataklang ding a, akiang ah ahon pai naisak ding. Ama'n amitel ngei tan in akiangnai ah apaisak ding hi.
english: and he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, “In the morning Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him: even him whom he shall choose he will cause to come near to him.

paite: Hichi in hih un, Korah leh apawlte tengteng aw, zingchiang in mei laknate tawi unla;
english: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;

paite: huai ah mei koih unla, TOUPA ma ah gimlim buak un. TOUPA'N atel peuhmah asiangthou ding. Levi tapate, na uang lua uh," chi in agen hi.
english: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Nou Levi tapate aw, ngaikhia unla,
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk nasep sem ding leh khawmpi nna sem dia khawmpite ma a dingh a, amah kiang a hon om naisak ding a, Israel Pathian in Israel omkhawmte a pan noute ahon omsak, nou a dia thil neuchik phet a kilang hia?
english: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahweh, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

paite: Amah kiang ah ahon om naisakta a, na kiang a na unau Levi tapa tengteng, siamputna leng na zong ua hia?
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? and do you seek the priesthood also?

paite: Huaiziak in nang leh na pawl tengteng TOUPA kalh in na kikhawm uh ahi. Aaron in bang ahih a ahia, atung a na phun uh?" achi hi.
english: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against Yahweh: and Aaron, what is he that you murmur against him?”

paite: Mosi in Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram asamsak a, "Amau ka hong paitou kei ding uh.
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up:

paite: Gamdai a hon that dia nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a pan na hon pikhiak thil neuchik ahi hia? Ka tung uah na kilalsak nawn ngal a.
english: is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ah na hon pilut kei a, lou ding leh grephuan gou ding lah na hon pe kei a; hiai mite mitte na mialsak ding maw? Ka hong paitou kei hial ding uh," achi uh.
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi aheh mahmah a, "TOUPA kiang ah, athillat uh sang ke'n. Asabiltung uh khat lel leng ka la kei, kuamah ka hih na kei," achi hi.
english: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering: I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Zingchiang in nang, na mi kikhawmte leh Aaron TOUPA ma ah ana om un.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow:

paite: Amei lakna uh tawi chiat uhenla, gimlim buak uhen. TOUPA ma ah amei lakna uh hon tawi uhenla, mei lakna zanih-le-sawmnga hon tawi uhen. Nang leh Aaron in leng na mei lakna uh tawi tuaktuak un," achi hi.
english: and each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”

paite: Huchi in michih in amei lakna uh atawi chiat ua, mei akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, Mosi leh Aaron toh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

paite: Korah in mipi tengteng ama ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah a-omkhawmsak a; mipi tengteng kiang ah TOUPA thupina ahong langta hi.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation against them to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the congregation.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mipi omkhawmte a pan kihuikhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

paite: Amau abokkhup ua, "Pathian aw, sa tengteng kha Pathian, mi khat khelh ziak in mipi omkhawm tengteng tung ah na heh dia hia?" achi uhi.
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Mipite kiang ah, Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan kihemkhia un, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

paite: Mosi athoutou a, Dathan leh Abiram kiang ah ava hoh a; Israelte upate'n azui uhi.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

paite: Omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai migiloute puanin a pan pawtkhia un. Abangmah uh khoih kei un, huchi lou in zaw akhelhna tengteng uah na pangkha ding uh," chi in agen hi.
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

paite: Huchi in Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan apawtkhe duamduam ua; Dathan leh Abiram ahong pawtkhia ua, apuanin kongkhak uah azite, atapate leh atanu neu chikchikte uh toh adingh uhi.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

paite: Mosi in, "Keimah lungsim a pawtkhia ahi kei a, hiai thilhih ding in TOUPA'N ahon sawl ahi, chih hiai ah na thei ding uh.
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

paite: Hiai mi tengteng dan bang lel a asih ua, mi tengteng gawt bang lel a gawt ahih uleh Pathian in kei hon sawl lou ahi ding.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N thil thak abawl a, lei in akam akat a, amau leh amau a tengteng avalh a, ahing a Sheol alut uleh bel hiai mite'n TOUPA ana hehsak uh, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if Yahweh make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain to them, and they go down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. ; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thu tengteng agen khit in anuai ua lei ahong khangkham phok hi.
english: It happened, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground split apart that was under them;

paite: Lei in akam aka a, a-inkuan un Korah mi tengteng, aneih tengteng uh toh avalh khin vekta hi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who appertained to Korah, and all their goods.

paite: Huchi in amau leh amau a tengteng Sheol ah ahing in atum vek ua, lei in akam achihkhum a, omkhawmte lak a pan amangthangta uhi.
english: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. : and the earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

paite: Huchi in akim ua Israel tengteng akikou husa uah ataizak ua, lei in ei leng ahon valh kha ding, achi uhi.
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

paite: TOUPA a pan meikuang ahong pawtkhia a, gimlim lanmi zanih-le-sawmnga ahong kanglumta hi.
english: Fire came forth from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Mei Laknate
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron tapa siampu Eleazar kiang ah thu gen inla, ama'n meikuang a pan mei laknate lakhe ding in hilh in, siangthou lah ahita ngal ua.
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire yonder; for they are holy,

paite: Ahinna tung mah a hiai mikhialte mei laknate maitam khuhna kuang ding in sek hi uhen, TOUPA ma a lat ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in asiangthou hi, huai Israel suante a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Yahweh; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

paite: Siampu Eleazar in mi kangte dal mei laknate ala a; maitam khuhna ding in asekta hi.
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

paite: Israel suante a dia theihgigena hi ding in huchi a Aaron tate hilou namdang himhim, TOUPA ma a gimlim hal dia ahong pai nailouhna ding un. Mosi zang a akiang a TOUPA'Nagen bang a, Korah leh apawlte bang ahong hihlouhna ding in.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the seed of Aaron, comes near to burn incense before Yahweh; that he not be as Korah, and as his company: as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

paite: Himahleh azingsang in, TOUPA mite na that uh, chi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Mosi leh Aaron tung ah aphun uhi.
heading: Aaron In Mipite Ahondam
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi leh Aaron tung mipi apunkhawm lai un, kihoupihna biakbuk lam a-en ua; ngai in, meipi in ahon khuh a, TOUPA thupina ahong kilang hi.
english: It happened, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the Tent of Meeting: and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahweh appeared.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiai mipi omkhawmte lak a pan kihemkhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi. Amau amai ua lei si in abokkhup uhi.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Na mei lakna tawi inla, maitam a pan mei koih inla; gimlim buak inla, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah paipih meng inla, amaute a ding in kilemna bawl in. TOUPA hehna ahong suak hi; hipi aleng panta," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

paite: Aaron in Mosi gen bang in atawi a, omkhawmte lak ah atailut a, ngai in, mipi lak ah huai hipi ahong leng pan a; gimlim abuak a, mipi a ding in kilemna abawl hi.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and behold, the plague has begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

paite: Misi leh mihing kikal ah adingh a, hipi akhawlta hi.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

paite: Huchi in Korah tungtang thu a site sim louh, hipi a si tengteng singkhat sangli-le-zasagih ahi uh.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.

paite: Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a Mosi kiang ah akik nawn a, huchi in hipi akhawlta hi.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the plague was stayed.
